Package gnu.x11.keysym

Class Vietnamese

java.lang.Object
gnu.x11.keysym.Vietnamese
public class Vietnamese extends Object
Vietnamese-specific keyboard symbols. Imported from XK_VIETNAMESE section of /usr/include/X11/keysymdef.h. Note that byte 3 = 0x1e.
